evidence.text: the overlay for the race state 0

the original at 0x2e0b4 holds 103 instructions and 357 bytes: it centers half of the object width at +0x134 and half of the object height at +0x120 on the 0x140 screen width, moves each axis position by the frame delta DAT_0018e08 times a step constant while the target stays above it, snaps the position down when the target stays below it, converts the x sum with the offset at 0x12d8 and each axis through the truncating helper at 0x4d9f4, draws the panels through panel_show at 0x2dfac, and draws the title at 0xbe with the font 0 and the color 2 through panel_draw_centered at 0x2e7cc when the state at DAT_00020988 is 1 or 2 and the low seven bits of the frame counter DAT_000007fd stay below 0x48

name: race_panel_0
role: draws the two smoothed race panels and the race state title
